# iXiehao

> Free, open-source Mac apps by iXiehao. Browse images with LumaView, convert videos with MP4Flow, and create video storyboards with ShotMap.

## Pages

- [English](https://ixiehao.github.io/index.md)

## Projects

- [MacBetter](https://ixiehao.github.io/MacBetter/llms.txt): Free and open-source macOS app directory; English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
- [LumaView](https://ixiehao.github.io/LumaView/llms.txt): Native macOS image and PDF viewer.
- [MP4Flow](https://ixiehao.github.io/MP4Flow/llms.txt): Local MP4 conversion and lightweight video editing.
- [ShotMap](https://ixiehao.github.io/ShotMap/llms.txt): Local video-to-storyboard sheets.

## Optional

- [Source and project documentation](https://github.com/ixiehao/ixiehao.github.io)
